adaptation: CombatFeel initialized once from ClientProxy. Camera reacts to observed client HP/absorption loss and native landing transitions. Exact world/body/connection/tick reset and bounded catchup prevent stale feedback across respawn or direct context swaps.

The raw AttackEntity event was input intent, not hit acceptance. Its success sparks/punch are instead triggered once by an admitted project-owned WeaponPulse SWING from the existing confirmed arsenal melee path. This does not add a new ordinary vanilla/native melee receipt protocol.

ScrollActorVfx retains all ten original shape families: fireball, firestream, vacuum, front, cannon, waterstream, shark, blade, dragon, thunder. Only own ScrollActor renderer selects them. Disguise/native entity render and other kinds retain existing handling.

Scroll trail cache is exact identity, max 128 entities and 24 positions each; sampled once at native END with exact world/entity-map membership. Fireball embers emit there, never per render; reduced motion/Quiet disables extra emission and freezes decorative phase.

VfxDraw voxel state is nested and scoped. Crescent matrix is restored in finally. Global generic cube budgets 1200/3000/9000 per observed render frame include the shared particle batches, in addition to per-effect and particle caps. Existing separate armor mesh is independently bounded.
VfxBudget LOD rejects detached/dead/foreign world entities; beyond48 blocks no procedural hand/scroll cue is drawn. MotionGate uses the optional shared detail/reduced-motion/Quiet preference.
